variants: Base: N equal columns; an image-only column becomes columns-img-col (text | image layouts).
variants.compare: Two comparison lists ('X are:' vs 'X are not:') with check/cross icon bullets.

suitableFor: closing CTA rows with a button beside an image
comparison lists with icon bullets (use the 'compare' variant)
notSuitableFor: three-or-more equal text columns that are really default-content lists
